name: Iori
message: 「...Excuse me.」
Dr. Sasaki seemed to be out, leaving Setsugekka in the care of another school nurse before stepping out of the room.
From what I heard, she had run a fever and been bedridden like this when she went berserk before, too.
Since she recovered completely the day after taking to bed, there probably wasn't much to worry about this time either, they said.

name: Iori
message: 「I hope she gets better...」
Even saying that, there's not much I can do.
There are other students in Takamura Class, too, so let's keep going with the introductions.

name: Momiji
message: 「Good afternoon.」
Just as I was about to go look for them, Suzakuin Momiji appeared from down the hallway.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, Momiji-san. Were you okay earlier？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, thank you very much for stepping in to stop things earlier.」

name: Iori
message: 「Good timing—I wanted to greet you, too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Regarding your appointment as sub-homeroom teacher for Takamura Class?」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh, how do you know about that？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I overheard you speaking with Kazamine-san from nearby.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, that makes things quick then. I'm Muragaki Iori, your new sub-homeroom teacher starting today. Nice to meet you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I am Suzakuin Momiji. It is a pleasure to meet you.」
Momiji gives a casual little bow. As expected of Suzakuin, perhaps—she's refined and very polite.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji-san, you're in the same Takamura Class as Setsugekka-san, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes... much to my regret, that is correct.」
Aha, so you really don't like her, huh...

name: Iori
message: 「I wanted to ask you—what kind of class is Takamura Class anyway？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Upon its establishment, Takamura Class consisted solely of myself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「The Suzakuin family values independence and strives to become self-contained swordsmen—that is our creed. Are you familiar with this？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course.」
The first head of Suzakuin was both a swordsman and an accomplished swordsmith.
Only you yourself can forge a blade worthy of entrusting your life to. The finest blade for oneself is born from within oneself.
Therefore, a Suzakuin swordsman forges their own blade by their own hand, and conducts their training solely through their own strength.
This is Suzakuin's golden rule, and it is reportedly enforced rigorously among members of the school to this very day.

name: Momiji
message: 「In that case, I believe you understand that those of Suzakuin generally do not seek a master.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Also, because I am a special scholarship student, I am exempt from all classes.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because of various special circumstances like that, the Year 1 Special A-Class, Takamura Class, was prepared for me.」
No need to receive instruction from teachers, and all classes are exempt. An anomalous existence who doesn't mesh with ordinary students.
So that's why a special class was made, is that it?

name: Momiji
message: 「However, right after enrollment began, a major problem occurred.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Difficult-to-handle students began appearing among the first-years, such as Kazamine Setsugekka-san whom I mentioned earlier.」

name: Momiji
message: 「At a loss, the academy side claimed it was to reduce the teachers' burden and, of all things, transferred them into Takamura Class.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because of that, Takamura Class ended up slapped with the dishonorable label of 'a class gathering only problem children whom ordinary teachers can't handle.'」

name: Momiji
message: 「As someone who has belonged to Takamura Class from the start, it is the height of <d0027>gritting my teeth in frustration</d>. It is extremely bothersome.」

name: Iori
message: 「A-ahaha... I see.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sasaki-sensei, who is the homeroom teacher of Takamura Class, is hands-off and does nothing, and Takamura Class's bad reputation knows no bounds.」

name: Momiji
message: 「For my part, I would be very grateful if Muragaki-sensei would pull Takamura Class together nicely.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's what I plan to do.」
There are plenty of unexpected parts, too, but since I was summoned by special dispatch appointment, this is a full-fledged mission.
Carrying out a mission responsibly to the very end. That is my pride.

name: Momiji
message: 「As I said earlier, I don't need a master, so I think I won't have much involvement with Muragaki-sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei, I truly hope you will strictly instruct the students other than me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ What are you saying？」

name: Iori
message: 「I intend to instruct you just like the other students.」

name: Iori
message: 「I was ordered to be the vice homeroom teacher of Takamura Class. And you're a student in Takamura Class. Then you're a student in the class I'm in charge of, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「I can't just leave my own students neglected.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei, I told you a moment ago too, I am a special scholarship student. Since classes are exempt, there is no reason to receive sensei's instruction...」

name: Iori
message: 「Scholarship student or whatever doesn't matter.」

name: Iori
message: 「Listen, a class is one team with everyone together. When someone's in trouble, someone helps out—mutual support is what matters！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Though Jindou is an individual sport and not a team match.」

name: Iori
message: 「You just don’t get it, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And you’re casually dropping honorifics with me, too!」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, Momiji, I feel like that actually suits you just fine.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t understand what you mean at all!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway, I don’t need your guidance, Sensei, and I’m not really fond of that overly intense ‘one team’ sort of thing.」

name: Momiji
message: 「As I said earlier, what Suzakuin aims for is ‘standing on one’s own.’」

name: Momiji
message: 「Please use your precious time and enthusiasm for guidance on everyone else who actually needs it.」
It was an unmistakable rejection.

name: Momiji
message: 「Excuse me, then. I wish you the best of luck, Muragaki-sensei.」
Smiling gracefully and offering a bow, Momiji took her leave.
